The '''Skeressa militia''' was the local defense force of [[Skeressa]]. During the the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], [[Skeedo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] hired individuals to hijack one of his rival [[Offra]]'s arms shipments to the militia.<ref>{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Underworld Trading|A Simple Job}}</ref>
